_schema._comment: DERIVED — regenerate with app/build_pipeline.py. Never hand-edit. Tier 1 status per case is LIVE (re-run at generation time), not read from case.json.qa, because that field is not even a consistent shape across the two real cases yet (cold-chain vs. tide-window) — see DOCTRINE_LEDGER 2026-08-01.

stage_definitions.concepting: A concept sheet entry (case-brainstorm output) with no cases/<id>/ directory yet, OR a legacy case whose dilemma isn't strictly binary (SPEC §1.4) and needs that design decision made first.
stage_definitions.drafting: case.json.status == 'draft' (case-write output), OR a legacy case with real usable narrative content not yet converted into case.md/case.json format. See legacy_signal{}/effort_tier for how much work that conversion actually needs — 'NEAR READY' still means real per-case authoring (boilerplate, deliverables, facilitator reformatting, interactive HTML/glossary), not a few clicks.
stage_definitions.research: case.json.status == 'researched' — case-research has filled placeholders with cited data or stated Modeling Assumptions.
stage_definitions.readiness: case.json.status == 'qa' — case-readiness's Tier 1/2/3 gate is the active blocker. tier1{} below is a live re-run, not a cached field.
stage_definitions.promotion: case.json.status == 'published' — case-publish has built the packet and promoted the case into cases_index.json/standards_spine.json.
stage_definitions.verified: A filed, filled cases/<id>/runs/RUN_*.md exists (Tier 3, MCS-29) — the only state that may carry a checkmark in DOCTRINE_LEDGER.
